tenderSchedule.title: Annual Maintenance to Kaujalgi- Channapur Cross SH-189 from Km. 0.00 to 5.33 and Alanvar- Betigere SH-140 KM 105.79 to 108.24 in Gokak Taluk of Belagavi District Under 3054-03-337-0-05-200 SH Road Maintenance for 2026-27
tenderSchedule.description: Annual Maintenance to Kaujalgi- Channapur Cross SH-189 from Km. 0.00 to 5.33 and Alanvar- Betigere SH-140 KM 105.79 to 108.24 in Gokak Taluk of Belagavi District Under 3054-03-337-0-05-200 SH Road Maintenance for 2026-27

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/CAT I/CAT II A/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in Multiple Transaction are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.

As per karnataka state government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01-01-2007 and Govt letter No.PW/134/BMS /2007/dated 27-07-2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders
All the documents to be uploaded shall be neatly scanned and the documents scanned shall be in original.
Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected.
Earnest Money Deposit will have to be in any one of the forms as per the instructions in the financial bid document and shall have to be valid for 45 days beyond the validity of the tender.
Tenderers are requested to read the Bid Documents before submission of their bid.
Department will not supply any materials, and the cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KP Procurement Portal.
The Employer reserves the rights reject one or all tender without assigning any reasons.

Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD Division Chikodi during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happened next working day will holds good in lieu of the dates mentioned
The Tenderer are should be present during opening of the tender and also submit the uploaded documents duly attested by the Gazetted Officer not below the Rank of Executive Engineer.
Contractors should Registered in KPWD and copy should be uploaded in E-portal Attested by the Gazzeted officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer.
The item rates are excluding GST but inclusive of all other charges.
GST shall be paid to the tendered amount separately.(As per prevailing rates GST will be Paid Separately)
The Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delays as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time
The Item Rate quoted shall include the Royalty Charges on construction materials and other taxes (excluding GST) as per prevailing Government Orders.
Difference amount should submit at the time of Agreement.
The Contractor should maintain the Road in good condition till end tender period.
Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27 in the Technical Qualification Criteria mentioned in the next section.

The Bidder, at his own cost, responsibility and risk, is encouraged to visit, examine and familiarize himself with the Site of Works and its surroundings including source of earth, water, road aggregates, availability of labor etc. and obtain all information that may be necessary for preparing the Bid and entering into a contract for undertaking the maintenance Works. The costs of visiting the site shall be at the Bidders own expense

The Contractor shall maintain the Road Assets in proper condition that comply with the Road Maintenance Standards and ensure users safety and comfort. The maintenance activities shall be so planned that the defects are repaired well before they reach maximum condition asper the permissible tolerance. After issuing the work order the contractor should complete 25% of the work every month.
If the contractor has not done the maintenance work satisfactorily in previous years such bids will be rejected.
If no bid received auto extension will be done by e-proc itself for 2 days.
The contractor should employe only registered labours as per government circular No. PWD/198/HMS/2009/ Dated: 24/06/2009 as per EPF and MP act 1952. In respect of the employe
Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN) form practicing Chartered Account is preferred.

Appeal as per the Government Ltr No. 572/CRM/2020/PWD-COMM-1-PWD-SEC, Dtated: 09-10-2020 the appeal received in e-proc as per KTTP act/rules within the stipulated time will only the considered. Any written appeal received shall not be considered.

As per Government Circular No. FD/263/EXP-12/2022, Dated 11/05/2022 Tender Clause ITT 24.3 If the Tenderer is not ready to make aggrement, Then the EMD amount will be forfeited and tender will be rejected

As per Government Circular No. PWD/48/BMS/2022, Dated 31/05/2024 and KTPP 2000 Rules 26(A) contractor are liable for debarment if contractor does bad quality of work, if contractor fails to complete the work within stupilated period of time and also to follow all other conditions mentioned in the above said Government circular.
Supply of tools and plants (spade, pic axe, pan, sickle) required for maintenance work is to be provided by the Tenderer.
Contractor should visit the site and should give certificate that he will maintain the road pot hole free up to the end of tender period

For CAT IIA contractors reservation category participate in the tender, the contractors should upload the domicile certificate stayed in KARNATAKA for minimum of 10 years issued by a competent authority / Tahsildar.

This Tender is invited for the Tenderers belonging to CAT IIA category only & to claim this reservation CAT IIA category certificate issued by the competent authority should be uploaded & should be submitted in original before tender opening.
If the Contractor is a firm, then all the partners or members of the firm shall belong to the CAT IIA or CAT IIA as the case may be
This tender is reserved for CAT IIA Contractors only

The Tenderer shall obtain any civil construction work the workdone certificate from financial year 2021-22 to 2025-26 (25% of the Amount Put to Tender i.e., Rs. 3.76 Lakhs) in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer(District Level Officer)and scan the Original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the Bid.

The Tenderer shall achieved in at least one financial years an average annual financial turnover from financial year 2021-22 to 2025-26 of Rs.15.06 Lakhs. (not less than the estimated cost under this contract)
The EMD of Rs. 19,000/- shall be paid in full through e-payment in favour of Executive Engineer, PWD, Chikodi Dn, Chikodi
Work Completion/Execution Period is 12 month including Monsoon.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -2- SITE CLEARANCE
itemList.description: Clearing    and    grubbing    road    land    including    uprooting    rank vegetation,  grass,  bushes,  shrubs,  saplings  and  trees  girth  up  to 300  mm,  removal  of  stumps  of  trees  cut  earlier  and  disposal  of unserviceable  materials  and  stacking  of  serviceable  material  to be used or auctioned,  including removal and disposal of top organic soil not exceeding 150 mm in thickness. By Mechanical Means using Dozer - In area of light jungle

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -10- MAINTENANCE  OF ROADS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Earth Shoulder (stripping excess soil) - Stripping excess soil from the shoulder surface to achieve the approved level and compacting with plate compactor. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3003

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -10- MAINTENANCE  OF ROADS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Earthen Shoulder (filling with fresh soil) - Making  up  loss  of  material/  irregularities  on  shoulder  to  the design level by adding fresh approved soil and compacting it with appropriate equipment.Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3003

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -10- MAINTENANCE  OF ROADS
itemList.description: Patching of Potholes - Patching of Shallow Potholes using SDBC Gr II 25 mm thick - Patching  of  shallow  potholes  on  asphalt  surfaces  by  using Semi Dense Bituminous Concrete 25mm thickness. The Cost is inclusive of removing the failed materials & cleaning on the road surface, preparation of potholes to the required standards sizes before patching them and application of tack coat at 0.20 kg/ m2 over the asphalt surface including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Drains - The maintenance of drains include erosion, repair, clearing, cleaning,  reshaping,  regrading,  deepening  of  side  drains as well as catch water drains as per technical specification Clause 1908. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1908

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: White  washing  of  parapet  walls  of  CD  work  and  tree trunks - White washing two coats on parapet walls and tree trunks including preparation of surface by cleaning scraping etc. as per technical specifications. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1916

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Culverts - Maintenance  of  Hume  pipe  Culvert  by  way  of    Clearing, Cleaning, Erosion repair, repairs to cracks, parapet wall and protection work as per drawing and technical specification Clause 1909. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1909

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -8- TRAFFIC CALMING MEASURES, ROAD SIGNAGES & MARKING (ROAD FURNITURE)
itemList.description: Retro-Reflectorised Traffic Signs - Providing    and    fixing    of    retro-    reflectorised    cautionary, mandatory  and  informatory  sign  as  per  IRC:67:2022  made of  Class  C  Type  XI  retro  reflective  sheeting  fixed  over   2  mm thick aluminium sheeting vide clause 801.3, 3mm/4mm thick Aluminium composite material sheet depending on the size of the  sign  fixed  over  the  back  support  frame  of  min  25  x  25  x 3mm  angle  mounted  on  a  mild  steel  circular  pipe  65  NB,  3.2 mm thickness firmly fixed to the ground by means of properly designed foundation with M25 grade cement concrete 45 cm x 45 cm x 60 cm, 60 cm below ground level as per approved drawing.The  sign  shall  be  maintained  as  per  section  12  of IRC:67:2022. - 60 cm equilateral triangle

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -8- TRAFFIC CALMING MEASURES, ROAD SIGNAGES & MARKING (ROAD FURNITURE)
itemList.description: Direction  and  Place  Identification  Signs  with  size  more than 0.9 m2 size Board. - Providing and erecting direction and place identification retro- reflectorised  sign  as  per  IRC:67:2022  made  of  high  intensity grade   sheeting   vide   clause   801.3,   fixed   over   aluminium sheeting, 2 mm thick or Aluminium composite material sheet with overall thickness of 4mm with area exceeding 0.9 m2  fixed over back support frame of min 40 x 40 x 5mm angle mounted on a mild steel circular pipe 65 NB, firmly fixed to the ground by  means  of  properly  designed  foundation  with  M25  grade cement concrete 45 x 45 x 60 cm, 60 cm below ground level as per approved drawing. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 801

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -8- TRAFFIC CALMING MEASURES, ROAD SIGNAGES & MARKING (ROAD FURNITURE)
itemList.description: Supplying  and  Fixing  of  Molded  Shank  Raised  Pavement Markers / Cats Eye made of polycarbonate and ABS moulded body and reflective panels with micro prismatic lens capable of providing total internal reflection of the light entering the lens face and shall support a load of 16000 kg tested in accordance to  ASTM  D  4280  Type  H  and  complying  to  Specifications  of Category   A   of   MORTH   Circular   No   RW/NH/33023/10-97 DO III Dt 11.06. 1997. The height, width and length shall not exceed 50 mm, 100 mm and 102 +/- 2 mm and with minimum reflective  area  of  13  cm2  on  each  side  and  the  slope  to  the base shall be 35 +/- 5 degree. The strength of detachment of the  integrated  cylindrical  shanks,  (of  diameter  not  less  than 19  +/-  2  mm  and  height  not  less  than  30+/-  2  mm)  from the  body  is  to  be  a  minimum  value  of  500  Kg.  Fixing  will  be by  drilling  holes  on  the  road  for  the  shanks  to  go  inside, without  nails  and  using  epoxy  resin  based  adhesive  as  per manufacturers recommendation and complete as directed by the engineer.The contractor shall submit a two year warranty for    satisfactory    field    performance    including    stipulated retro-reflectance   of   the   reflecting   panel,   to   the   Engineer. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - MoRTH 806

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -3- EARTH WORK, EROSION CONTROL AND DRAINAGE
itemList.description: Scarifying the existing bituminous road surface to a depth of 50 mm and disposal of scarified material by Mechanical Means using Hydraulic excavator with in all lifts and lead. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 305.4.3

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -4- SUB-BASES, BASES (NON-BITUMINOUS), SHOULDERS AND STABILIZATION METHODS
itemList.description: Granular Sub-Base - By Mix in Place Method - Construction  of  Granular  Sub-Base  of  required  grading  as  per design     spreading   in   uniform   layers   with   motor   grader   on prepared surface mixing by mix in place method with front end loader at OMC and compacting with vibratory roller to achieve the desired density, complete as per clause 401 - For Grading -V Material. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 401

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -4- SUB-BASES, BASES (NON-BITUMINOUS), SHOULDERS AND STABILIZATION METHODS
itemList.description: Wet Mix Macadam (Plant Mix Method) - Providing,   laying,   spreading   and   compacting   graded   stone aggregate to wet mix macadam specification including premixing the Material with water at OMC in mechanical mix plant carriage of mixed Material by tipper to site, laying in uniform layers with paver/grader in sub-base / base course on well prepared surface and compacting with vibratory rollerto achieve the desireddensity. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 406

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -5- BASES AND SURFACE COURSES (BITUMINOUS)
itemList.description: Prime Coat over WMM/WBM - Providing  and  applying  primer  coat  with  SS1  grade  Bitumen Emulsion   on   prepared   surface   of   granular   base   including cleaning of road surface and spraying primer at the rate of 0.70 kg/m2  using mechanical means. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 502

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -5- BASES AND SURFACE COURSES (BITUMINOUS)
itemList.description: Tack coat on Granular surface treated with primer - Providing  and  applying  tack  coat  with  VG-10  Bitumen  using pressure  distributor  at  the  rate  of  0.25    kg/m2    on  Granular Surface. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 503

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -5- BASES AND SURFACE COURSES (BITUMINOUS)
itemList.description: Bituminous Macadam Grading - II for traffic <20 MSA - Providing  and  laying  Bituminous  Macadam  with  40/60  TPH capacity    hot  mix  plant  using  crushed  aggregates  of  specified grading  premixed  with  bituminous  binder  VG-30  @  3.4%  by weight of mix, transported to site, laid over a previously prepared surface  with  mechanical  paver  finisher  to  the  required  grade, level and alignment and rolled as per clauses 501.6 and 501.7 to achieve the desired compaction. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 504

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -5- BASES AND SURFACE COURSES (BITUMINOUS)
itemList.description: Semi Dense Bituminous Concrete - Providing  and  laying  Semi  Dense  Bituminous  Concrete  with 40/60  TPH  capacity   hot  mix  plant  batch  type  using  crushed aggregates of specified grading premixed with bituminous binder VG-30  @  5%  by  weight  of  mix  and  filler,  transported  to  site, laid over a previously prepared surface with mechanical paver finisher to the required grade, level and alignment and rolled as per MoRTH V revision. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - IRC-37:2018

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -3- EARTH WORK, EROSION CONTROL AND DRAINAGE
itemList.description: Construction of Subgrade and Earthen Shoulders - Construction of sub-grade and earthen shoulders with approved material   obtained   from   borrow   pits   with   all   lifts   &   leads, transporting  to  site,  spreading,  grading  to  required  slope  and compacted to meet requirement of table No. 300-2. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 305

Patching of deep potholes using WBM Gr II & SDBC GR II 25 mm thick Patching of deep potholes 75mm thick by restoring the Granular Base course using material confirming to WBM garde -II with Type B Screening standards wherver necessary by manual means including trimming the pothole to the required shape and size, cleaning the pothole,Applying Prime Coat (SS1) at 0.7 kg per m2 over the WBM surface and covering the surface with SDBC 25mm thick including lead ,loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., Complete as per standard specification.
"
